subject: Post-call qualification: procurement timeline, PO vs card, and MAP
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sara Dunne <sara.dunne@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-15T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: Procurement readiness & next steps

Hi Sara — great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our discovery so we have a shared reference and clear next steps for procurement readiness. High-level notes: 

- Commercial path options you mentioned: purchase order (preferred), corporate card (possible for smaller pilots), or cloud marketplace (Marketplace listing may speed procurement if available).
- Procurement flow at Acme (as you described): Legal review -> Security questionnaire -> Finance approval -> PO issuance.
- Rough timing you signaled: legal 1–2 weeks, security questionnaire dependent on engineering availability (~1 week), finance/PO another 1 week once SOW/quote approved.

Attached: Redwood-Estimate-Acme-0706.pdf (estimate + pricing tiers)

Proposed mutual action plan (MAP) — please confirm owners/dates: 
1) Finalize target model & pilot scope — owner: Acme (Sara) — target by 2026-07-22
2) Redwood to share SOW + final quote for PO — owner: Redwood (Vanessa) — target by 2026-07-17
3) Acme legal review of SOW/terms — owner: Acme legal — target complete by 2026-07-29
4) Security questionnaire returned to Redwood — owner: Acme security/engineering — target by 2026-07-24
5) Finance issues PO (Workday) / choose payment instrument — owner: Acme finance — target by 2026-08-05

Questions I need from you to keep things moving: 
- Confirm preferred payment instrument (PO vs card vs marketplace).
- Please share the security questionnaire (or confirm if I should send Redwood's standard template).
- Any procurement routing notes (e.g., charge codes, SOW countersignature requirements, vendor onboarding links)?

If PO is the path, we will prioritize an invoice-ready SOW and a billing contact in the HubSpot deal. If marketplace is possible, please flag and we can route the procurement team to marketplace listing options and lead times.

Next steps: I will circulate a draft MAP and an invoice-ready SOW for PO processing by Friday 7/17. Can we tentatively book a 15-min check-in for 7/23 to confirm legal/security progress?

Thanks — looking forward to moving this to procurement-ready.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
(415) 555-0124

Attachment: Redwood-Estimate-Acme-0706.pdf (pdf, 2 pages)

From: Sara Dunne <sara.dunne@acme.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-15T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement readiness & next steps

Thanks, Vanessa — this looks good and aligns with how we typically run these engagements. A few quick notes: 

- Payment instrument: procurement prefers a PO for pilots of this size; finance will sign once the SOW is invoice-ready.
- Legal: I’ll route the SOW to our legal team when you share it; they typically take ~10 business days but can be faster for standard terms.
- Security: attaching the baseline questionnaire our security team uses — hope this helps (Acme-Security-Checklist.xlsx). Engineering will own completion but I can push to get it back within ~5 business days.
- Marketplace: we don’t currently buy through marketplace for this org; that might be an option in future but not for this pilot.

Agree on the 7/23 check-in.

Best,
Sara
Director, Data Platform | Acme Corp
sara.dunne@acme.com
Attachment: Acme-Security-Checklist.xlsx (xlsx, 1 sheet)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Dunne <sara.dunne@acme.com>
Date: 2026-07-16T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-call: Procurement readiness & next steps — internal MAP + asks

Forwarding Sara’s reply with updates. Action items for Redwood: 

1) Pricing/discount confirmation — Marissa, can you confirm whether we can offer a 10% pilot discount and prepare an invoice-ready SOW (SOW-draft.docx) for Acme? Target: 2026-07-17.
2) Legal/terms support — Vivek, if legal needs an expedited outline for our standard terms against Acme’s checklist, can you coordinate with Legal Ops? Aim to reduce turnaround to 7 business days if possible.
3) Security questionnaire — I will upload our standard security addendum and a short answers doc to the shared drive; Sara attached Acme’s baseline.
4) HubSpot / procurement fields — I’ll update deal record with payment instrument = PO and attach the estimate.

Proposed MAP (compact view): 
- 2026-07-17: Redwood shares SOW + invoice-ready quote (owner: Redwood)
- 2026-07-22: Acme confirms pilot scope & sign-off (owner: Acme)
- 2026-07-24: Acme returns security questionnaire (owner: Acme)
- 2026-07-29: Legal sign-off (owner: Acme legal)
- 2026-08-05: Finance issues PO in Workday (owner: Acme finance)

Notes: if Acme decides to use a corporate card for initial E2E verification, we can accept a smaller initial payment and convert to PO for production — but Sara confirmed PO is preferred. 

I’ve attached a Draft-MAP.md to the deal record for visibility. Once Marissa confirms pricing I’ll send the SOW to Sara to start legal routing.

Vanessa

Attachment: Draft-MAP.md (markdown)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Sara Dunne <sara.dunne@acme.com>
Date: 2026-07-16T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call: Procurement readiness & next steps — internal MAP + asks

Thanks Vanessa — I can confirm we can make a pilot-level accommodation: 10% one-time pilot discount (applied to initial term) and we’ll prepare an invoice-ready SOW by EOD 7/17. I’ll also include a short clause that highlights standard Redwood billing and PO acceptance language to speed finance processing.

Vivek — if legal can prioritize a quick review (target 7 business days) once Acme routes the SOW, that should keep the MAP on schedule.

Vanessa/Sara — I’ll add a pricing note to the HubSpot deal and attach the SOW when ready. Book the 7/23 check-in and we’ll use it to validate legal status and security return.

—Marissa
VP, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachment: Pricing-Note-ACME-07016.txt (txt, 1 page)
